reviews.comment: class and HW are super easy, the tests are so hard (3). Not that good at explaining things, but she knows what she is talking about. If you can teach yourself, have some knowledge about stats, and want an easy B take her class. She is pretty funny and sometimes gives extra credit. 1 group project + final is a paper (takes time but not to bad)
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She does a great job of teaching the information, although sometimes it may be necessary to get help on some things outside class, everything you need is taught in the lecture. Half of the class is free as she walks with you through the homework as long as you show up to class. Pop quizzes happen for extra credit sometimes so make sure you show up.

reviews.comment: I had to take SOCI220 for my major. She lets you have a piece of paper for the tests, but even writing down everything won't help with with how she words the questions. Refuses to curve even though more than half of the class failed the tests. Has a final paper, but she is very critical and grades super hard. My least favorite professor ever!
